name: BACKROOMS
detailed_description:
Survive the Endless.

Step into the eerie, ever-changing world of the Backrooms — a place beyond reality, filled with endless hallways, buzzing lights, and things best left unseen. Built on procedural generation, no two runs are ever the same. Every room, every sound, and every shadow could lead you closer to freedom... or deeper into the madness.

Key Features:

  • Procedural Levels – Explore infinite, randomly generated environments that evolve the deeper you go. Each playthrough offers new layouts, challenges, and threats.

  • Steam Workshop Support – Dive into custom-made levels and experiences crafted by the community. Create, share, and explore endless possibilities.

  • Atmospheric Horror – Minimal UI, immersive sound design, and psychological tension build a uniquely unsettling experience. It’s not about what you see… it’s about what you feel.

  • Dynamic Objectives – Solve puzzles, find clues, and make crucial decisions. Some paths lead to safety. Others… don’t.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad CPU Q6600 @ 2.40GHz / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 2GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
